hypothesis: The delivered three-core B40 image a88ebdf5 at 90 MHz serves an 8 GiB device window over HBM[0:31] with the current runtime: the RTL address path is 64-bit end to end (evidence/r41/hbm8 audit) and the xclbin connects all three outlets to the 8 GiB group, so the R40 4 GiB window was an allocation choice, not a limit.
competing_explanations: XRT refuses or places differently an 8 GiB BO in MBG[0:31] on this image (host memory, group map)
a platform/interconnect address-map segment narrower than the xclbin connectivity drops PC16-PC31
a high address bit is lost in RTL that the audit and RTL simulation missed (aliasing probes)
generated kernels scale int32 element offsets in 32-bit arithmetic (bigoffset/stream only)
host transfer path cost or memory for multi-GiB transfers (diagnostic, not a window limit)
expected_counter_changes: outlet read/write line deltas on all three outlets for the probe kernels
each launch issues and completes programs on all three cores (peak_active 3)
stream: outlet read lines x 64 B >= the 2.25 GiB storage for one row reduction
R_AXI_STAT error/stray bits stay clear after every case
expected_observations: window: 8 GiB XRT BO in MBG[0:31], R_AXI_BASE/SIZE/STAT readback, heap = window, PC0-PC31 contiguous
negatives: allocator/host/MMIO refusals at the 8 GiB end, host window last word, reserved TMU page
samples: 34 probes: every PC boundary, both BO edges, virtual 4 GiB; DMA in, 3-core device add, DMA out
alias: bit 30/31/32/32+31 address pairs and TMU page + 2/4/6 GiB: distinct device load/store values
crossing: device store-load across virtual 4 GiB, physical 4 GiB and the window end; DMA out and in
dma: 256 MiB DMA in at the window top, device copy to 6 GiB, 2 x 256 MiB DMA out
clamp: hbm_bytes 16 GiB exposes exactly the 8 GiB group

board.load_policy: never loads: runs only on the B40 image a88ebdf5 already loaded by the Stage 1 queue; every fpga step probes the loaded UUID, the clock counter and kdsstat first and refuses otherwise

registration.order: as listed; one process per case
registration.launch: evidence/r41/hbm8/launches/hbm8_queue.sh (after the Stage 1 queue; never loads)
registration.simulator_twin: hbm8_manifest.py --sim: the same steps on fpga-multicore-sparse-sim
